name: post
description: Local mail connector: Claude reads, searches and drafts mail over IMAP (macOS, Linux) or through classic Outlook (Windows).
long_description: post. connects Claude to your own mailbox. post. itself runs on this computer only; whatever Claude reads from your mail goes to Anthropic like any other chat content. Replies land as drafts in your mailbox. You check them and send them yourself.

tools.name: mail_accounts
tools.description: Shows the connected mailboxes and what the AI may do.

tools.name: mail_folders
tools.description: Lists folders with total and unread counts.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Lists or searches mail, newest first, across accounts and folders.

tools.name: mail_read
tools.description: Reads one mail in full, optionally with the whole thread.

tools.name: mail_attachment
tools.description: Reads the text of an attachment (PDF, Word, Excel, text).

tools.name: mail_draft
tools.description: Creates a draft, a reply or a forward, optionally straight in an Outlook window.

tools.name: mail_discard_draft
tools.description: Deletes a draft the AI created.

tools.name: mail_move
tools.description: Moves a mail to another folder.

tools.name: mail_delete
tools.description: Deletes a mail: to the trash, or for good when explicitly asked.

tools.name: mail_mark
tools.description: Marks a mail as read, unread or for follow-up.

email.title: Mail address
email.description: Your address; post. looks up the server settings itself.

password.title: Password or app password
password.description: Gmail, iCloud and Yahoo require an app password.

allow_organize.title: Allow sorting and deleting
allow_organize.description: The AI may move mail into folders, delete it to the trash, mark it as spam and mark it as read or important. Reading and drafting always work.
